title: Necessary sixth-norm noise bound
statement: Let $\rho\in\mathbb R$. If, for every $a,b\in\mathbb R$, the sixth-norm of $a+\rho b\varepsilon$ is at most the $2$-norm of $a+b\varepsilon$ for a uniformly chosen sign $\varepsilon\in\{-1,1\}$, then $\rho^2\le 1/5$.
hypotheses_covered: For every $a,b\in\mathbb R$, the stated norm inequality holds
